name: Sherd: Fragment from the Base of a Circular Bowl with Flat Floor, Slightly Rounded Walls, and Straight Footring
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；11th century；Probably Ru ware: light gray stoneware body with pale bluishgreen glaze, the exterior glaze with white to buff cloudiness due either to under firing or to burial (in the waste heap at the kiln site). Probably from the Ru kilns, Henan province
